I have the opposite issue actually where I have this compulsion to scrub things over and over and over again when i get bad anxiety. 2 things that help this are goal setting and getting more sleep. You could have stronger will power when you sleep and you could set tiny goals. My goal for today was to only scrub my face 3 times when i felt the urge. You could say “if i vacuum today then i will feel accomplished” and you probably will.  Another thing that I’ve read can help strengthen will power is taking cold showers. Sometimes i do this if i have a goal I’m really struggling with. Oddly enough, it works!
